infact.justification: While Joe Biden's income fluctuated significantly—rising to over $11 million in 2017 and $4.5 million in 2018 due largely to book deals, before decreasing to $944,737 in 2019 [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2020/09/29/joe-biden-releases-2019-tax-returns-ahead-of-presidential-debate.html)—there is insufficient data to confirm a consistent upward trend for the couple. Although the Bidens reported an increase in assets between $2.2 million and $8 million in July 2019 [Source](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joe_Biden), and Jill Biden earned at least $700,000 from speaking engagements [Source](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/biden-earned-millions-after-leaving-white-house-financial-reports-shows), the lack of specific annual income data for Jill Biden in 2019 makes it impossible to determine if their combined total income showed a documented upward trend leading up to October 2020.
